paper_metadata.title: Effect of Nb additions on microstructure and properties of γ-TiAl based alloys fabricated by selective laser melting
paper_metadata.journal: Transactions of Nonferrous Metals Society of China

evidence.quote: The γ-TiAl based Ti−Al−Mn−Nb alloys with different Nb additions were fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM) on the TC4 substrate.
采用选区激光熔化技术， 在TC4 合金基体上制备不同 Nb 含量的 γ-TiAl 基 Ti−Al−Mn−Nb 合金。
